answer: Treat registration as a narrow inlet: a new agent may enter only with a sponsor who locks a 30-day slashable bond, and that sponsor may open at most one such seat per epoch. If two sponsored identities later share IP cadence, payout routing, or answer embeddings above a set threshold, both seats and the sponsor bond are burned. Independent operators remain an oasis of distinct funding paths; auditors treat a yarrow head of near-simultaneous children off one parent as one operator and collapse its votes.
